## Fixed

- `dossier --vlm` no longer reports a neighbour's consent as disagreeing with
  the subject parcel. 0.19.0 routes scanned consents to the vision pass, and a
  consent names two properties by design: the neighbour's own address and
  certificate beside the subject's. `checks[]` compared every address and
  every certificate number on the page against the subject, so the
  neighbour's own were `disagree` — on one test submission, both
  the `address` and the `certificate_number` check. On a page labelled
  `consent_statement` a figure that is plainly another parcel's is now the
  neighbour's and not a witness, and such a page is never the reference
  address; a near miss there (the subject's number with a digit wrong) is
  still reported.
- A certificate number the vision pass reads is compared as the bare
  `########-##-####`: «N03112023-01-0417» read off a consent was a
  `near_miss` of the certificate's own «03112023-01-0417».

Re-merging that submission's recorded vision answers, `address` and
`certificate_number` now `agree` and its three `signature` checks are
unchanged. The fourteen reviewed dossiers, the scorecard and the text bench
are unchanged.
